verdict.rationale: The only direct segmentation evidence is a pricing-page line item, "Predictive Segmentation" [mailchimp-docs-10]. Adjacent items show behavioral and purchase data reaching the audience: Magento order data used for targeted emails [mailchimp-docs-23] and per-recipient click tracking [mailchimp-docs-21]. None of these describes a segment builder, so support is glancing. Missing for 10: documented segment builder combining profile attributes, tags, and behavioral events; evidence that segments update automatically as data changes; tag-based segmentation; independent or hands-on corroboration.
